author: opencode-worker-6
text: Worker-6 pre-flight survey (claiming next): the Python oracle is python/src/lichen/coap/params.py congestion_service_unavailable (5.03 + Max-Age:retry_after + CBOR {reason: duty_cycle, retry_after: N, level: normal|elevated|critical|exhausted}; defaults 120, clamp neg->0). The C hal has lichen_duty_cycle_ctx with remaining_ms()/next_tx_available_ms()/can_transmit() (hal/include/lichen/duty_cycle.h:63-74) — no congestion-level mapping exists yet, so the load-shedding trigger site needs (1) a duty->level mapping and (2) the emission points (coap_status.c observe slot-full, waypoints, location, rangetest — all currently bare 5.03 for UNRELATED policies; the duty-cycle gate itself is a new emission site per R-07-031). Plan: implement a respond_duty_cycle_load_shedding helper in coap_status.c mirroring params.py byte-for-byte, and gate mutating handlers on can_transmit()==false. Validation via the coap_location_beacon host harness (has OSCORE stubs).
